caption: The drawing features three depictions of a hat or bonnet, which appears ornate and is decorated with a rosette and ribbon. The central and largest depiction, located in the upper left quadrant of the paper, is rendered in full color and detail. The hat is a pale orange or peach hue with ruffled, layered, frilled edges and is accented by a large, glossy black bow on the top right, as well as a white or gray ribbon extending downward. Nearby, two smaller, less-detailed line drawings of the same hat are positioned diagonally below and to the right of the main colored image. These two are sketched in graphite or pencil only, without color, but retain the same overall shape and bow details. The background is plain and unadorned, with an off-white or beige color. In the bottom right corner, the name "M. Concha" is written in small letters.
title: Bonnet
